title: Fribourg edge Massagno to lift SBL trophy
description: Massagno - Fribourg 77-91 Fribourg celebrated SBL title. They upset Massagno in Game 4 of the Finals to lift the 22nd SBL title. The game was mostly controlled by Fribourg. Massagno managed to win second period 22-19. But it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. The former international forward Natan Jurkovitz (202-1995) fired 20 points, 6 rebounds, 4 assists and 4 steals for the winners. American point guard Eric Nottage (187-1994, college: FIU) chipped in 17 points and 7 assists. Nottage is a former Eurobasket Summer League player, which is considered top international summer league in the market. Fribourg's coach Thibaut Petit used a ten-player rotation which allowed the starters a little rest for the next games.
